dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Sparring Grounds
大观园 公认武斗对练场
dataList.content:
Hey... you're one of the Shi boys.
你是……史家子弟的一员呢。

... Hmph! We finally meet. I had hoped to fight you in the Family Hierarch war.
……哼！正好，我还为没能在家主之争碰上你而遗憾呢。

If you'd run into me then—
但凡被我逮到……

Isn't this supposed to be a sparring match? Why does it sound like you have a personal grudge against me?
我觉得你说的话不像是在切磋，而像是怀恨于我，为什么？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Oh, it's nothing. Nothing at all~ Why in the world would I ever hold a grudge against you?
是错觉，错觉~我怎么会恨你呢？

The results of the Family Hierarch war couldn't be any clearer, and everyone even remotely connected to the mess has all been dragged away and put under investigation.
家主之争的结果是明确的，动乱的所有相关人员都在接受彻底调查。
And hey, guess what! They dragged away half of my family, which means more room for me... I should really thank you, right? 托这福气，我们家一半的人都被带走了，房间变得非常宽敞……所以我真该谢谢你。对吧？

Honestly, why don't you just declare a war against the Shi family at this point? Wouldn't that be much easier?
怎么，你倒不如直接向史家发起战争呢？这不比把你看不顺眼的家伙全抓起来方便多了？

War's not "easy". It never is.
别轻易把战争说出口。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
W-what are you on about all of a sudden...?
什、什么？干嘛突然搞这么……

... It's not something we should be talking so lightly about. Even as a joke.
……那不是能像开玩笑般说出来的词。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Your family was arrested because they are under investigation for treason against Daguanyuan. If they're innocent, I'm sure they'll be released soon enough.
当初他们涉嫌反叛大观园。如果没有，他们很快将会被释放。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Tsk, I know it's pretty much a given that they'll all be ruled as guilty, regardless of what really happened. You know I can't even pay them a visit because you've hidden their cells all over Hongyuan?!
嘁，说得好听，到头来不还是全都要被判成有罪吗？甚至连拘留所都被藏在鸿园中，家人想探视也去不了！

They're not hidden. All holding cells within Hongyuan have always been designed to move around in very short intervals.
拘留所没被藏起来。鸿园中所有的监狱用房，在过去都被设计成会按照短周期更换位置。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... You know, that does seem like the kind of design that would lead people to make some unfortunate assumptions. Though I'm sure the initial purpose was to prevent escapes.
我也觉得……这样的设计很容易引起误会。唉，虽然原本的用意是为了防止逃跑就是了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I recently gained a better understanding of Hongyuan's structure, so I'm planning to change our policies so that prisoners still on trial are allowed to have fixed locations.
我已经摸清大部分构造了，近期打算改造以固定未决犯的位置。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... Really? Where'd you—
……真的吗？你怎么会……

I was lucky enough to take a few excellent classes recently.
多亏最近听了那么好的课。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Managed to reflect upon myself a bit, too.
我也慢慢学会回头审视自己了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Huh... you did change a little.
你……跟以前不一样了。

Still, you better not expect me to go easy on you... I've got my own things to take care of!
但我也有我的立场……所以别想着我能让着你！

Good. Come on, let's do this.
再好不过了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Many illustrious Fixers of the past have said... that naught but disparagement awaits unjust victories!
优秀的收尾人们曾说……若不是赢得堂堂正正的胜利，就只配被嘲讽！
dataList.title:
